text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ..."There's someone I want you to meet".  After accepting Satsuki's invitation, {0} returned to the oni village in Gio Nivlhel once again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──「会わせてぇヤツがいる」。
サツキからの提案を受けて、
{0}は
再びジオ・ニヴルヘルにある鬼族の村へと戻ってきた。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Dark as ever. That's the sky of Gio Nivlhel for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──……暗ぇな。
ジオ・ニヴルヘルの空は。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: It's strange. Born here, and it still feels foreign.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしなもんだ。
生まれ故郷だってのにな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: This matter's not urgent. Let's rest for now, brat Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺のは急ぎの用
ってワケでもねェ。
ひとまず休むか、
騎士公。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...It's no big deal. Duchess Lisa's arrow was nothing more than a flesh wound.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どってことねェよ。
リザ公の矢なんざ、
かすり傷みてぇなモンだしな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: Lady Satsuki! Pardon the intrusion right after your return, but there's a report...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
サツキ様！
お帰り早々すいやせんが、
ご報告がございまして……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Talk.
text_block_list.orig_text: 聞かせろ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: We have received news that a zombie village at the foot of the Yasha Pass is being attacked by a horde of drifted-up monsters. They are asking for immediate help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夜叉峠の麓にあるゾンビの村が、
流れ着いたモンスターの群れに襲われているとの報せが。
大至急救援が欲しいと。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: That place, huh... What about the youngsters?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あすこか……
若い衆は？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: They're already tied up with relief in other areas and the standoff at the "Deep Garden". If we move anyone now, we'll be stripping this village to bare bones.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが、
他の地域の救援や
『深い庭』の睨み合いに……
動かすとなると、
この村の最低限の人員を割く他ありません。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: No time to recall them now. And pulling the guards off the village makes no damn sense either...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今から呼び戻しても
間に合わねェな。
村の守りの手前らを出すのも勘定が合わねェし──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped, guess I'll have to handle this. I'm leaving holding the fort up to you guys again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃぁねェ、
出張るとすっか。
また留守を任せるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: ...As you wish.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……御意。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: My bad, brat Knight. Kick back and have some tea or something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪ぃな、
騎士公。
茶でも啜って寛いでてくんな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Just so you know, brat Knight. I owe you one for that Spirit Orb mess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あのな、
騎士公。
『反魂の霊玉』の件じゃ感謝してるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Which is why I'm not planning to take any more favors from you before I'm even done repaying one. Too many debts, and I'll be up to my neck.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからこそ、
その恩を返し終えない内に借りは増やせねェ。
借金だらけで、
首ィ回んなくなっちまうからな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: You might not care, but I sure as hell do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんが気にしなくても、
俺が気にする
っつってんだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: You damn fool, quit spouting nonsense~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ばっきゃろう、
屁理屈抜かすな──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hm! Tch. Time's running out. Feel free to do as you please.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
チ。
時間がねェ。
好きにしゃあがれ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: One thing. If things get dicey, you have to shout for me. No, better yet -- haul ass and run. That's the deal. Got it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただし、
ヤバくなったら大声で俺を呼べ。
いや、
尻に帆ォかけて逃げろ。
それが条件だ。
いいな？

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyverns
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa. Look at these damn skeletons strutting around like they own the place. Not a scrap of cheek meat left on you, is there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おうおう。
骨どもがヒト様のシマで、
デケェ面しやがって。
頬肉だって残っちゃいねェだろうが。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Here's my warm welcome. BREAK!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──挨拶代わりだ。
砕けな！

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyverns
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyverns
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. One out and here comes the other...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──チッ。
ぞろぞろと……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Oi, brat Knight. I'll hold these bastards off. You go find anyone left behind and get them back to the village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
騎士公。
魔物どもは俺が引き付けておく。
その間に
逃げ遅れた連中を捜して鬼の村に戻れ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry about me. I'll catch up to you in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……心配すんな。
すぐに追いつく。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Now, I'll open you a path. RUN...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
道を開くぜ。
──走れ……！

text_block_list.name: Female Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: Over here...! This way...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっち、
こっちよ！

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: W-We did it! We're saved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やった！　
俺たち
助かるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyvern
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: Eeek! One of the monsters is coming after us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぃっ、
魔物が一匹
追ってきてる！

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyverns
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Female Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: No good, there are monsters up ahead, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメよ、
この先にも
魔物がいるわ！

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's all over... We've got no choice but to die here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
もう終わりだぁ……
俺たちみんなやられるしかないんだ……

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: ...S-She's not coming! There's no way Lady Satsuki would come here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こ、
来ないじゃないか！
サツキ様がこんなところに来るわけが……

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyverns
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEKKKKK!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひぃぃぃっ！！

text_block_list.text: You don't need to do that.
text_block_list.orig_text: その必要はねェよ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Spin. "Hexagonal Burial: Pulling Vajra"..!
text_block_list.orig_text:
廻れ。
──
『六角納骨・
引き独鈷』……！

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyvern
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Somehow I made it in time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どうにか間に合ったか……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait, brat Knight. Your voice reached my ears.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待たせたな、
騎士公。
手前の声、
しっかり耳に届いたぜ。

text_block_list.name: Bone Wyverns
text_block_list.text: Guooooooohhh! Gooooohh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──グオオオオオッ！
──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Wyvern of Bones
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Female Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: T-These boney monsters have merged...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
骨が合体しちゃった……！？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Think just bulking up's gonna help you? Don't think you can stand against me with your guts all shriveled up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
図体デカくすりゃァなんとかなるってか？
肝っ玉落っことしたママで、
太刀打ちできると思うなよ──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ッらア！

text_block_list.name: Giant Wyvern of Bones
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: Amazing, she's pushing it back...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい、
押してるぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Female Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: ...But isn't Lady Satsuki acting a little strange? She's not acting like her usual self. It feels as if she's moving to cover some injuries...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
サツキ様の様子、
ちょっとおかしくないかしら？
いつもの動きじゃないわ。
ときどき、
ケガをかばう
みたいな動きが……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. These bones sure got backbone... Heh. What a lame joke. I'm turning into Duchess Gre.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──チッ。
骨だけに、
骨がある──……
寒ぃな。
グレ公かってんだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Speaking of Duchess Gre... Looks like that shoulder wound she gave me back then opened up again. And that's not all—
text_block_list.orig_text:
グレ公といや。
こないだ奴からもらった肩の傷が、
開いちまったか。
他にも──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: The sword wounds caused by Yatogami and the frostbite that ice dragon lady made my body suffer. What's more, the hole in my chest courtesy of Duchess Lisa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤトガミに斬られた刀傷と、
氷の竜の嬢ちゃんにもらった凍傷。
ついでに、
リザ公に開けられた胸の穴──

text_block_list.name: Giant Wyvern of Bones
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: You should've shown up two days earlier, dammit...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一昨日きやがれ、
ってんだ……！！

text_block_list.name: Giant Wyvern of Bones
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, YOU BASTARDS! This isn't a show! RUN! THE ONI VILLAGE IS JUST AROUND THE CORNER!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おい、
手前ら！
見せもんじゃねェんだ、
走れ！
鬼の村はもうすぐそこだ！

text_block_list.name: Female Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: Let's go, we'll just get in her way...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行きましょう、
私たちは邪魔になるわ……！

text_block_list.name: Male Zombie who didn't escape
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! ...Lady Satsuki, please be sure to win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はいっ……！
……
サツキ様、
必ず勝ってくださいね！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...I just told you to run away, didn't I? You sure are a stubborn one, brat Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
逃げろ
ってんだろうが。
手前も頑固だな。
騎士公。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Heh. Fine... I concede.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──へっ。
しゃぁねぇ……
俺の負けだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Can you lend me a hand, brat Knight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひとつ、
手ェ貸してくれるかィ。
騎士公よ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: All right... Our objective is to destroy that lump of bones into pieces before it regenerates...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし……
あの骨の塊、
再生しちまう前に
まとめてぶち割ってやるしかねぇが……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: After receiving your enhancements, I'll need some time to prepare my attack. So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんの強化を貰った上で、
俺の側がひとつ気息をタメる必要がある。
だから──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. It seems I didn't need to explain. My thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
話がはえぇな。
助かるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Giant Wyvern of Bones
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Fuuu!

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Hexagonal Burial...
text_block_list.orig_text: 『六角納骨──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ..."VAJRA DROP"!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──陰入蟻落とし』！

text_block_list.name: Giant Wyvern of Bones
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *swoosh*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ズズーン……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……やれやれ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Don't worry about me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おう。
心配すんねィ……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Just a few scratches... or so I'd like to say. But even small cuts add up after a while... damn it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かすり傷ばっかりだ──
って
いいてぇトコだが。
チリも積もればなんとやら、
だな。
こりゃ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...You know, at first, I thought you were just some scrawny kid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
最初はな。
なよっちぃ小僧だと思ってたんだよ。
お前さんのこと。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Figured you might be some smooth-talking conman trying to cozy up to the princess or something. But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
言葉巧みに、
お姫に取り入ったペテン野郎か何かじゃねェか
ってな。
けど──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...My apologies. Guess my eyes were too clouded to see straight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……すまねェな。
どうも、
俺の目が曇っちまってたらしいや。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: あ？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Haahahaha--Khhh...~
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁっはっはッ──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...! D-Don't make me laugh. It'll open up my wounds...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ッ……！
わ、
笑わすなよ。
傷が開くだろが……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. I'm going to sleep. I'm borrowing your back as a pillow, brat Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──
寝る。
背中借りンぜ。
騎士公。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Don't forget, yeah? I still got someone I want you to meet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……会わせたいヤツがいる
って約束、
忘れんなよ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day. {0} was taken to a certain place by Satsuki, who had just woken up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
翌日。
目を覚ましたサツキに連れられて、
{0}はある場所に来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: The village graveyard. The one I wanted you to meet is here... yeah, right there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この村の墓場だ。
会わせたいヤツってのがここに……
ああ、
そこだ、
そこ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: My sister rests beneath this headstone. Wanted to let her see your face at least once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この墓石の下に、
俺の妹が眠ってんだ。
いっぺん
お前さんの面ァ
拝ませときたくてな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. And not just her face... how could I put this... her aura. They were alike.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ。
顔じゃなく……
なんつうか、
雰囲気
ってやつがな。
似てたんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Though, that's all there is to it. In the first place, that ghost was no Onifolk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
つっても、
それだけだがな。
そもそもあの幽霊、
鬼族じゃねェし。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it doesn't change the fact that I couldn't just leave her alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ま、
放っておけなかったことにゃ
変わりゃしねぇが。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Guess that's clean enough. Thanks for helping out, brat Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……掃除は
こんなもんか。
手伝ってくれてあんがとよ。
騎士公。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...See? This guy's praying for you too. Bet that makes you happy, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……この兄ちゃんも、
祈ってくれるってよ。
良かったな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Now then. Let's get down to business. We, the oni tribe, have a custom of making vows in front of graves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
さて。
こっから本題だ。
俺たち鬼族には、
墓前で誓いを立てる
っつぅ風習がある。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Past this recent incident. Because I'm such a pathetic person, I've been indebted to you, an outsider, many times.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回の一件に限らず。
俺が不甲斐ねぇもんだから、
余所もんのお前さんに
デカい恩を何度も受けちまった。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: So I swear to you, I will owe you this great debt with my entire life──
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから誓うぜ。
この大恩、
俺の一生を懸けて──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...What? I'm being serious here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……んだよ。
こっちゃ真面目なんだぞ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Are you even listening to me? I have to settle things. You're an outsider...
text_block_list.orig_text:
話聞いてんのか。
俺ぁケジメつけなきゃなんねェんだ。
余所もんから──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Haha! Wahahahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハハッ！
ワアッハッハッハ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Certainly, yeah... it would be rude to force a debt upon a friend in return for their kindness...
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
な──
ダチの親切に、
借りを押し付けるのも野暮ってか……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: My bad, guess I messed up that introduction earlier. Let me do it right this time -- let me introduce you to my sister again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪
かったな、
ちっとばかり紹介の仕方を間違えたらしい。
改めて、
俺の妹に紹介させてくれや。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: This guy... He's my buddy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつァ──
俺のダチ公だ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After two incidents, the spirit orb incident and the rescue of the zombie village, {0} formed a strong bond with Satsuki and was welcomed by the oni as Satsuki's buddy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
霊玉騒動とゾンビ村への救援という二度の事件を経て、
サツキとの固い絆を結んだ{0}は、
サツキのダチ公として鬼族に歓迎されるのだった。
